items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Jackie Robinson had just became a news person on NBC, and I saw this ad for TV, TV school

ctx.x: And I was looking through a Sunday Times Magazine Section, and Jackie Robinson had just became a news person on NBC, and I saw this ad for TV, TV school, and I thought, well, you know, if he's in front of the mike, maybe

I could be behind the mike, you know, And so I went over and took the course and -- as class producer, had all the qualifications of becoming a director, which was my ambition. But I would have settled for anything then except a grip.
